faq1a: Basmet Dawah is a free, guided way to learn Islam, whether you are curious, new to Islam, or a Muslim who wants to learn more. One question shows you where to start, then short lessons walk you through it step by step, so you never have to guess what to learn next.
faq2a: Yes, completely free. There are no subscriptions, no hidden fees, and no paid tiers.
faq3a: No. You can browse paths and lessons without one. Creating a free account saves your progress, your saved lessons, and your starting point answers, so you can pick up where you left off on any device.
faq4q: How does the starting point check work?
faq4a: A short set of questions asks where you are in your practice today, things like prayer, wudu, and what you already know. Based on your answers, we place you at a stage and recommend the path to start with. There is no way to fail it.
faq5a: English, Arabic, and Spanish, with full right to left support for Arabic.
faq6q: I found an error in a lesson. How do I report it?
faq6a: Please use the form on this page or email us directly. We appreciate every correction and update lessons as soon as we can.
faq7q: How do I volunteer as a mentor?
faq7a: Open the Talk to a mentor page and choose "Volunteer as a mentor". Our team will follow up with the next steps.
